text:
If this video were made by a agency they’d charge $50,000 but I created it in just 10 minutes.

Images generated with Nano Banana Pro. Video created with Seedance 1.5 Pro using the first and last frames. https://t.co/s1UCMp0a9d
content: Create a video in Seedance 1.5 Pro by supplying the first and last frames as keyframes to guide the generation.

translations.es: Crea un video en Seedance 1.5 Pro proporcionando el primer y último fotograma como keyframes para guiar la generación.
translations.fr: Créez une vidéo dans Seedance 1.5 Pro en fournissant les premières et dernières images comme images clés pour guider la génération.
translations.ja: Seedance 1.5 Proで、最初と最後のフレームをキーフレームとして提供し、生成をガイドすることでビデオを作成します。
translations.ko: Seedance 1.5 Pro에서 첫 번째와 마지막 프레임을 키프레임으로 제공하여 생성 과정을 안내하는 비디오를 만드세요.
translations.pt-BR: Crie um vídeo no Seedance 1.5 Pro fornecendo o primeiro e o último quadro como keyframes para guiar a geração.
translations.zh-CN: 通过提供首帧和末帧作为关键帧来指导生成，在Seedance 1.5 Pro中创建视频。
